recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一大團黏聚的小圓形腫瘤細胞，細胞沿放射狀排列，圍繞中央一團淡藍紫色纖維狀的神經纖維網（neuropil），形成 Homer Wright 玫瑰花結（rosette），是神經母細胞瘤轉移的特徵。
features: Large cohesive aggregate of small round tumor cells arranged radially around a central core
Central pale fibrillary neuropil-like material with no lumen, forming a Homer Wright rosette
Tumor cells with high N:C ratio, scant cytoplasm and round hyperchromatic nuclei
Surrounding dispersed tumor cells and residual hematopoietic cells, with streaks of blood/plasma in background
Scale bar 100 um indicates a low-power view; fine chromatin detail is not assessable
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows a large cohesive aggregate of small round cells with scant cytoplasm and hyperchromatic nuclei arranged radially around a central core of pale fibrillary neuropil-like material, forming a Homer Wright rosette. Numerous similar cells are dispersed around the aggregate, with few residual hematopoietic elements. Fine nuclear detail is limited at this magnification. In an infant with a suprarenal mass, findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by metastatic neuroblastoma, supported by synaptophysin, chromogranin and CD56 positivity on the biopsy.

ddx.vs: ALL blasts are discohesive single cells without rosettes or neuropil, and are TdT/CD19/CD34-positive and synaptophysin-negative.
Ewing sarcoma may form rare rosettes but lacks prominent neuropil, and shows membranous CD99, NKX2.2 and EWSR1 rearrangement.
Rhabdomyosarcoma cells can cluster and mimic leukemia but have vacuolated cytoplasm, lack neuropil rosettes and are desmin/myogenin-positive.
These may form rosettes too (Flexner-Wintersteiner or Homer Wright), and separation requires clinical primary site and PHOX2B/ancillary studies rather than aspirate morphology.
